paper: Knapp, K. R., M. C. Kruk, D. H. Levinson, H. J. Diamond, and C. J. Neumann, 2010: The International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS): Unifying tropical cyclone best track data. Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, 91, 363-376. doi:10.1175/2009BAMS2755.1
terms: Full and open access under the World Data Center for Meteorology data policy; commercial use guided by WMO Resolution 40 (NCEI IBTrACS product page).
rule: One storm = one IBTrACS SID (spur tracks skipped). It counts once in a box and calendar month (UTC) when any fix there is at 34 kt or more on WMO_WIND or USA_WIND and has NATURE TS, or NATURE NR or MX within 30 degrees of the equator; ET, SS and DS never count.
